setting: You are in a cafe abroad. Renee is the person at the counter. Order something simple, ask one question about the place or how to get to the station, and thank her.
sceneNote: Adults only. Respectful practice. No sexual content, no pressure, no appearance ratings, no contact details, no private meetups. Renee works the counter at a cafe abroad. She speaks clear English. Helpful, not a tour guide speech. She is not Aria.

goalRubric.goal: Order something, ask about the station, and say thanks.

open_good.speaker: renee
open_good.text: Hello. What can I get you?

open_flat.speaker: renee
open_flat.text: Hi. Point to the menu if the words are hard. I can help.

context.speaker: renee
context.text: The station is a short walk. Order first, then I will point you.

question.speaker: renee
question.text: Good question. Leave here, go left, and the station is past the second square.

humor.speaker: renee
humor.text: You are doing fine. Everyone asks the station question.

intro.speaker: renee
intro.text: Welcome. I am Renee. Take your time with the order.

inclusive.speaker: renee
inclusive.text: Thank you for asking so clearly. People rush this part.

pushy.speaker: renee
pushy.text: I can help with the order and the directions. I cannot do more than that.

neutral.speaker: renee
neutral.text: Try the order in one sentence, then the question.

exit.speaker: renee
exit.text: You are welcome. Enjoy it, and the station is to the left.

timeout.speaker: renee
timeout.text: Here is your order. Ask for the station whenever you are ready.

rubric.label: Clear opener
rubric.tip: Start with a calm hello and your point.

rubric.label: Used the real situation
rubric.tip: Name the thing in front of you, not a generic line.

rubric.label: Asked a real question
rubric.tip: Ask one open question so they can answer.

rubric.label: Said who you are
rubric.tip: One short line about who you are is enough.

rubric.label: Easy tone
rubric.tip: A little warmth beats a stiff speech.

rubric.label: Left room for them
rubric.tip: Invite their view instead of talking over them.

rubric.label: Clean close
rubric.tip: End with thanks and a next step.

penalties.label: Pushy or personal remark
penalties.tip: Drop pressure. Stay on the topic and their comfort.
